item.title: Three teens accused of false report during Breckenridge death investigation
item.description: BRECKENRIDGE, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) - Three 19-year-olds are accused of making false reports to a peace officer during a death investigation in Breckenridge. Authorities say the investigation into the false reports began on October 19, 2025, in connection with the death of Zach Smith.
